connector.name: ChiefLab
connector.registryDescription: Open execution contract for agents doing business work. 6 operators, one MIT-licensed spec.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.chieflab.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bdentech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer clp_live_<your-key> or clp_dev_<your-key>. Get one at https://chieflab.io/get-key (one click, no email) or programmatically via the chieflab_signup_workspace tool. Raw key (no `Bearer ` prefix) is also accepted for gateway compatibility.

env.name: CHIEFLAB_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer key. Get one at https://chieflab.io/get-key. Or run `npx @chieflab/cli login` after install for a saved-config alternative.
